workflow.title: Uninstalling a Mac app or investigating returning storage?
workflow.primaryIntent: Choose whether a specific unwanted app/orphaned files or recurring storage growth is the actual problem before authorizing changes.
workflow.descriptionDirection: Pearcleaner documents uninstall/orphan-search tools; storage that returns calls for investigation rather than indiscriminate removal. Do not assume leftover-looking files are disposable.
outline: Lead with the remove-an-app versus understand-growth decision; official Pearcleaner visual immediately after lead once cleared
Inventory the app and retained data before deciding what can go
Explain documented uninstall, orphan-search and optional Trash-triggered cleanup, with maintenance-pause and permissions caveats
If storage returns, inspect changes over time instead of treating every large folder as an orphan
Show labeled Breathing Room Space example and explain size versus available space
Use a review checklist: owner, retained data, backup, rebuild cost, exact location/method, and uncertainty
Bounded recommendation with affiliation and honest cases for choosing Pearcleaner
workflow.interactionPassRequirement: Non-mutating decision checklist: want to remove a known app / unsure which data belongs to it / investigating recurring growth. Show review questions, not delete commands or savings estimates.
